description:
## What

Extract §6.1.3(d)+(e) policy-tree update (lines 2210–2308, the dominant 99-line block) into `pub(crate) fn update_policy_tree_from_cert(cert: &Certificate, state: &mut WorkingState, ...) -> Result<()>`.

## Risk

HIGH. The dominant policy-tree mutation step.

## Tree-NULL invariant (PKIX-als9 design §7)

> "the tree becomes NULL when no nodes at depth ≥ 1 check (currently 3 identical sites: 2300–2303, 2509–2514, 2823–2826) must be preserved."

If prep3 (`policy_tree_post_op_prune`) has landed, H9 uses that helper at the post-op point. If not, H9 inlines the equivalent check.

## Dependencies

- H8 (sequenced).

## Acceptance

- New helper.
- "tree becomes NULL" invariant preserved at the H9 boundary.
- All PKITS policy tests pass (§4.8–§4.12).
- clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
title: als9: H9 — extract update_policy_tree_from_cert (~99 lines, §6.1.3(d)+(e))
